result.instructions: Tools for A-Cube, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices did we send in September, and have the SDI delivery receipts arrived?"; "Show the SDI notifications of invoice number 2026/118: was it delivered or rejected?"; "List my draft invoices and show me the oldest one before I send it.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes A-Cube data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run acube_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run acube_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run acube_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. acube_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: acube_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: Sent and received Italian e-invoices (SDI) of the account: uuid, invoice number and date, document type (TD01...), sender and recipient, amounts, marking and notification status. Filter by date, number, document type, party name or VAT number. GET /invoices.

invoice_date_from.description: Invoice date on or after this day.

invoice_date_to.description: Invoice date on or before this day.

created_from.description: Created in A-Cube on or after this day.

created_to.description: Created in A-Cube on or before this day.

document_type.description: SDI document type, e.g. TD01 (invoice), TD04 (credit note), TD17-TD19 (reverse-charge self-invoices).

sender_vat_number.description: Sender VAT number code (digits, without the country prefix).

recipient_vat_number.description: Recipient VAT number code (digits, without the country prefix).

downloaded.description: Only invoices already downloaded (true) or not yet (false).

items_per_page.description: Items per page, 1 to 30 (default 30). A full page means there may be more: ask for the next page.

tools.name: acube_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: One invoice by uuid: metadata plus the FatturaPA JSON payload (parties, lines, VAT, payment), or the XML file sent to the SDI. GET /invoices/{uuid}.

tools.name: acube_list_invoice_notifications
tools.title: List an invoice's SDI notifications
tools.description: The SDI notifications of one invoice (delivery receipt RC, rejection NS, outcome NE, failed delivery MC, deadline expiry DT...), with their type, date and status: how you tell whether an invoice was delivered or rejected. GET /invoices/{uuid}/notifications.

tools.name: acube_get_notification
tools.title: Get an SDI notification
tools.description: One SDI notification by uuid, with its payload. GET /notifications/{uuid}.

tools.name: acube_get_invoice_stats
tools.title: Get invoice statistics
tools.description: Counters of invoices and notifications for a year (annual; monthly or daily detail only if A-Cube activated it), for the whole account or one fiscal id. GET /invoices/stats/{year}.

fiscal_id.description: Only this customer's fiscal id (a business registry configuration).

tools.name: acube_list_draft_invoices
tools.title: List draft invoices
tools.description: Draft invoices that were created but not yet sent to the SDI. Same filters as acube_list_invoices. GET /invoices/draft.

invoice_date_from.description: Invoice date on or after this day.

invoice_date_to.description: Invoice date on or before this day.

items_per_page.description: Items per page, 1 to 30 (default 30). A full page means there may be more: ask for the next page.

tools.name: acube_get_draft_invoice
tools.title: Get a draft invoice
tools.description: One draft invoice by uuid, with its FatturaPA JSON content. GET /invoices/draft/{uuid}.

tools.name: acube_validate_invoice
tools.title: Validate an invoice (no save)
tools.description: Checks an invoice against the FatturaPA rules without creating or sending anything; returns the validation result or A-Cube's errors. POST /invoices/validate.

fattura_elettronica_header.description: FatturaPA header as A-Cube JSON (snake_case keys): dati_trasmissione (codice_destinatario, pec_destinatario), cedente_prestatore (seller), cessionario_committente (buyer). Give the full header (seller and buyer) for a draft you intend to send: A-Cube only fills in transmission data automatically, and acube_validate_invoice shows what is missing.

fattura_elettronica_body.description: Exactly one invoice body (an array with one object), snake_case keys: dati_generali (dati_generali_documento...), dati_beni_servizi (dettaglio_linee, dati_riepilogo), optional dati_pagamento. Field names as in the A-Cube Italy API reference.

tools.name: acube_create_draft_invoice
tools.title: Create a draft invoice
tools.description: WRITE: saves a new invoice as a DRAFT in A-Cube. Nothing is sent to the SDI until acube_send_draft_invoice. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two drafts. Validate first with acube_validate_invoice. POST /invoices/draft.

fattura_elettronica_header.description: FatturaPA header as A-Cube JSON (snake_case keys): dati_trasmissione (codice_destinatario, pec_destinatario), cedente_prestatore (seller), cessionario_committente (buyer). Give the full header (seller and buyer) for a draft you intend to send: A-Cube only fills in transmission data automatically, and acube_validate_invoice shows what is missing.

fattura_elettronica_body.description: Exactly one invoice body (an array with one object), snake_case keys: dati_generali (dati_generali_documento...), dati_beni_servizi (dettaglio_linee, dati_riepilogo), optional dati_pagamento. Field names as in the A-Cube Italy API reference.

tools.name: acube_send_draft_invoice
tools.title: Send a draft invoice to the SDI
tools.description: WRITE: accepts a draft and transmits it to the Sistema di Interscambio. This is a legal act: a sent e-invoice cannot be recalled (only corrected with a credit note) and may be billed by A-Cube. Without confirm: true it only returns the draft for review. Show the draft to the user and get their explicit OK first. POST /invoices/draft/{uuid}/send.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually send. Otherwise the draft is returned as a preview.

annotations.title: Send a draft invoice to the SDI

tools.name: acube_delete_draft_invoice
tools.title: Delete a draft invoice
tools.description: WRITE: permanently deletes a draft invoice (a draft only: a sent invoice answers 409). Without confirm: true it only returns the draft. DELETE /invoices/draft/{uuid}.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually delete. Otherwise the draft is returned as a preview.

tools.name: acube_list_receipts
tools.title: List electronic receipts
tools.description: Electronic commercial receipts (scontrini) with number, date, status, type (sale, void, return) and totals. GET /receipts.

fiscal_id.description: Only this business's receipts (its fiscal id).

status.description: Receipt status, as shown in the list.

type.description: Receipt type, e.g. sale, void, return.

document_date_from.description: Receipt date on or after this day.

document_date_to.description: Receipt date on or before this day.

items_per_page.description: Items per page, 1 to 100 (default 30). A full page means there may be more: ask for the next page.

tools.name: acube_get_receipt
tools.title: Get an electronic receipt
tools.description: One electronic receipt by uuid: type, status, number, date, total and links to voiding or returned receipts (no line items: use acube_get_receipt_details). GET /receipts/{uuid}.

tools.name: acube_get_receipt_details
tools.title: Get electronic receipt details
tools.description: The line items and VAT, discount and taxable totals of one electronic receipt. GET /receipts/{uuid}/details.

tools.name: acube_list_business_registry_configurations
tools.title: List business registry configurations
tools.description: The businesses (fiscal ids) set up on the account, with which services are on: customer invoices, supplier invoices, receipts, signature, legal storage. GET /business-registry-configurations.

supplier_invoice_enabled.description: Only businesses that receive supplier invoices (true) or not (false).

receipts_enabled.description: Only businesses with electronic receipts on (true) or off (false).

items_per_page.description: Items per page, 1 to 100 (default 30). A full page means there may be more: ask for the next page.

tools.name: acube_get_business_registry_configuration
tools.title: Get a business registry configuration
tools.description: One business by fiscal id: name, email, enabled services and its webhook configurations. GET /business-registry-configurations/{fiscalId}.

fiscal_id.description: The business's fiscal id (codice fiscale or partita IVA).

tools.name: acube_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhook configurations
tools.description: The webhooks (events and target URLs) configured on the account. Authentication keys and tokens are never returned. GET /api-configurations.

fiscal_id.description: Only webhooks of this business (fiscal id).

items_per_page.description: Items per page, 1 to 30 (default 30). A full page means there may be more: ask for the next page.

tools.name: acube_list_numbering_sequences
tools.title: List numbering sequences
tools.description: The invoice numbering sequences (name, year, last number). GET /numbering-sequences.

items_per_page.description: Items per page, 1 to 100 (default 30). A full page means there may be more: ask for the next page.

tools.name: acube_get_current_numbering_sequence
tools.title: Get the current numbering sequence
tools.description: The sequence now in use for a sequence name. Its number is the LAST number used: the next invoice gets that number plus one. GET /numbering-sequences/current/{name}.

tools.name: acube_list_jobs
tools.title: List background jobs
tools.description: Background jobs (invoice, report and zip downloads, F24 and daily receipt report downloads) with status ready, started, completed or error. GET /jobs.

items_per_page.description: Items per page, 1 to 30 (default 30). A full page means there may be more: ask for the next page.

tools.name: acube_get_job
tools.title: Get a background job
tools.description: One background job by uuid with its status and result. GET /jobs/{uuid}.

tools.name: acube_verify_fiscal_id
tools.title: Check a fiscal id
tools.description: Checks whether a codice fiscale or partita IVA is valid. GET /verify/fiscal-id/{id}.

id.description: The fiscal id or VAT number to check, e.g. 12345678901.

tools.name: acube_verify_company
tools.title: Look up an Italian company
tools.description: Basic registry data of an Italian company by VAT number (name, address, status), optionally with the split-payment check. GET /verify/company/{id}.

id.description: The company's VAT number or fiscal id.

check_split_payment.description: Also tell whether the company is subject to split payment.

tools.name: acube_get_recipient_code
tools.title: Get the SDI recipient code
tools.description: The account's 7-character SDI recipient code (codice destinatario), the address customers put on invoices they send to you. GET /users/me/recipient-code.

prompts.title: Get started with A-Cube
prompts.description: What you can do with A-Cube here, with example requests to try.
